# Rushan Haque — Web Developer & Website Designer, Moradabad, India

> Rushan Haque is a web developer and website designer based in Moradabad,
> Uttar Pradesh, India. He builds custom websites, interfaces and web
> applications for businesses in Moradabad and across India, and has delivered
> projects for clients in Saudi Arabia, Poland and Nepal. Work covers the
> build itself plus SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Key facts

## Services

- **Website design and development** — custom business websites, portfolio
  sites and landing pages, built from scratch rather than from a template.
- **E-commerce development** — product pages, carts and checkout flows built
  to work on phones and slow connections.
- **Web application development** — custom tools, dashboards and product
  front-ends.
- **SEO** — technical SEO, local SEO and on-page work for Google rankings.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** — structuring sites so AI
  assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews cite
  them as a source.
- **UI and UX design** — interface, layout, typography and motion.
- **Digital marketing** — performance campaigns measured against outcomes.
- **Cloud solutions and hosting** — infrastructure that scales under load.
- **ERP and CRM systems** — operations and customer-relationship systems.
- **Social media management** and **video editing**.
- **Writing** — essays, site copy and long-form work.

## Service pages

- [Website design and development](https://www.rushanhaque.in/website-design-development): Rushan Haque designs and builds custom websites for businesses across India, from a base in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh.
- [E-commerce website development](https://www.rushanhaque.in/ecommerce-website-development): Custom online stores built for how India actually shops: mostly on a phone, often on an unreliable connection, and increasingly paying by UPI.
- [Web application development](https://www.rushanhaque.in/web-application-development): Custom web applications for businesses whose process does not fit an off-the-shelf product: internal tools, dashboards, booking and inventory systems, and product front-ends.
- [SEO services](https://www.rushanhaque.in/seo-services): Technical, local and on-page SEO for businesses in India.
- [Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.rushanhaque.in/generative-engine-optimization): GEO is the work of becoming the source AI assistants cite.
- [Website redesign](https://www.rushanhaque.in/website-redesign): A redesign that begins with a diagnosis rather than a mockup.
- [Landing page design](https://www.rushanhaque.in/landing-page-design): A landing page has one job and one action.
- [Website speed optimization](https://www.rushanhaque.in/website-speed-optimization): Speed work measured the way visitors experience it: a mid-range Android phone on mobile data, not a desktop test on office broadband.

## Common questions

**Who is Rushan Haque?**
A web developer and website designer based in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, India,
building custom websites and web applications for clients in India and abroad.

**How much does a website cost?**
Cost depends on scope — a single-page site costs far less than an e-commerce
build or a custom web application. Quotes are made per project rather than sold
as fixed packages.

**How long does a website take?**
Timeline follows scope and feedback speed. A straightforward business site
moves fastest; e-commerce and custom applications take longer. Every quote
carries a timeline.

**Does he work outside Moradabad?**
Yes — remote-friendly, with delivered work across India and in Saudi Arabia,
Poland and Nepal.

**Does he do SEO as well as the build?**
Yes, both SEO and GEO are offered alongside development.
